**Directions: **Study the following information carefully to answer the given questions:

If on 6th January, 2001 it was Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 25 November, 2001?
solution:
We have to calculate the remaining days from 6th January to 25th November

Days in January = 25

Days in February = 28

Days in March = 31

Days in April = 30

Days in May = 31

Days in June = 30

Days in July = 31&
